title: Pages will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled
body:
Starting in December 2026, [Pages](/aws/en/uc-semantics/pages) will be available by default for workspaces with the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled. This applies to workspaces with no compliance standard selected or with the HIPAA, PCI-DSS, C5, TISAX, or HITRUST compliance standard selected. Workspaces with any other compliance standard can't use Pages. See [Limitations](/aws/en/uc-semantics/pages#limitations).

Pages are governed definitions of business concepts, such as critical terms, entities, and acronyms, organized by domain on the **Discover** page. Genie One prioritizes Page definitions over context it infers automatically and cites the Page in its answers.

See [Pages](/aws/en/uc-semantics/pages).
